shell_toasts_action_started: Toast after an atlas.yaml action was started from the palette or a key. {action} is the action's own label from atlas.yaml, shown as is.
shell_toasts_atlas_yaml_created: Toast after Atlas wrote an atlas.yaml for a discovered folder. {name} is the project name.
shell_toasts_branch_preserved: Toast after deleting a worktree whose branch was kept because it was not merged. {branch} is the branch name.
shell_toasts_checked_out_elsewhere: Error toast when git refuses the switch because the branch is checked out in another worktree. {branch} is the branch; {path} the other worktree's folder.
shell_toasts_copied_url: Toast after the connection URL of a service (a database, a queue) was copied. {url} is the URL.
shell_toasts_created_and_switched: Toast after creating a branch from the branch picker and switching to it. {branch} is the new branch name.
shell_toasts_seed_cloned: Part of the toast shown when a new worktree is ready: which folders were cloned from the main checkout. {dirs} is a comma-separated list of folder names; {ms} is milliseconds.
shell_toasts_seed_failed: Detail shown after a folder name in the new worktree toast when seeding that folder failed with no reason from the backend.
shell_toasts_seed_not_relocatable: Part of the toast shown when a new worktree is ready: a Python virtualenv folder cannot be copied. {dir} is the folder name.
shell_toasts_seed_unsupported: Part of the toast shown when a new worktree is ready: folders that were not cloned because the file system cannot. {dirs} is a comma-separated list of folder names.
shell_toasts_setup_time: Part of the toast shown when a new worktree is ready: how long its Setup command ran. {duration} is a formatted time such as 1.5 s.
shell_toasts_stash_body: Body of the stash confirmation. {message} is git's own explanation, shown as is, then the question.
shell_toasts_stash_confirm: Confirm button of the stash confirmation: stashes the local changes and switches branch.
shell_toasts_stash_title: Title of the confirmation when a branch switch would overwrite local changes.
shell_toasts_switched: Toast after switching the worktree to another branch. {branch} is the branch name.
shell_toasts_switched_stashed: Toast after switching branch with the local changes stashed. {branch} is the branch name.
shell_toasts_unknown_worktree: Error toast in the branch picker: the branch is checked out in a worktree that is not in the project list. {name} is the branch; {path} the folder.
shell_toasts_worktree_deleted: Toast after a worktree was deleted.
shell_toasts_worktree_failed: Error toast when the worktree creation failed and the backend gave no message of its own.
